name: Vanilla Finest Fixes
description: Fixes and small tweaks for the mods in the Vanilla Finest modpacks, each module bound to the mod versions the packs ship. Iris: turns Improved Transparency (Fabulous graphics on 1.21.1) back on when shaders are disabled, and on 26.3 fixes the enchantment glint crash. Better Clouds: toggle key, automatic Mellow cloud preset, clouds hidden behind Voxy terrain. Elytra Contrails: fewer trail checks. Touch'n Motion: riders look where the player faces with third-person camera mods. Atmospherics (26.3): no AirHaze crash with Improved Transparency. ImageIO: no temp file per image read. Voxy (26.2+): keeps Vulkan selected and switches Voxy off for that session; shader packs' distant-terrain shaders compile when they use a value Iris does not have on this Minecraft version. Each module only runs when its mod is installed in a version it was made for.
